name: Obat Helpers
mission: Our mission is to equip underserved communities in Bangladesh with the tools they need to break free from the cycle of poverty. We do this by providing access to quality education and economic empowerment programs, promoting financial independence and inclusive economic growth. Our ultimate goal is to build a more equitable and prosperous Bangladesh for all.
theoryOfChange: Equip underserved communities with tools to break free from poverty by providing access to quality education and economic empowerment programs.

strengths_deep_dive: OBAT Helpers demonstrates solid operational focus by allocating <cite id="12">82.1% of its total expenses</cite> to direct relief and education programs in FY2024. This beats the <cite id="1">industry standard benchmark of 75%</cite>. Additionally, the organization holds <cite id="1">a Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid</cite> and scored a <cite id="1">90.3 out of 100 on Charity Navigator</cite>, reflecting strong governance practices and operational transparency.
rich_narrative.summary: OBAT Helpers is a dedicated nonprofit focused on empowering displaced populations, particularly Bihari camp residents and Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh. Founded in 2004, the organization addresses intergenerational poverty through integrated programs in education, healthcare, WASH, and youth development. In FY2024, OBAT Helpers reported <cite id="12">a total revenue of $1,591,131</cite>, down from $2,184,558 in FY2023. Despite this financial contraction, the charity maintains strong programmatic focus, directing an <cite id="12">84.8% program expense ratio</cite> toward direct relief and development services. The organization delivers services at high cost-efficiency, reaching thousands of vulnerable families each year with direct aid and basic education.
